workflowUpgrade.incompleteComparison: A before/after result is missing. This is not a completed comparison.
workflowUpgrade.recordedUnits: Values retain the recorded metric units. Differences describe these tests, not future returns or an execution failure.
workflowUpgrade.truncatedEvidence: The record limit excluded {count} otherwise eligible runs.
workflowUpgrade.coverageNotCompleteness: Selected records establish attribution, not complete market coverage. Missing or excluded evidence remains a limitation.
workflowUpgrade.discardDraft: Your unsaved changes will be discarded. The saved definition and any running task stay unchanged.
workflowUpgrade.staleData: Update failed. Showing the last successful snapshot from {time}.
workflowUpgrade.readFailed: This resource could not be loaded. Retrying automatically.
workflowUpgrade.rerunConfirm: Start a new run with the current saved definition? This may perform new actions within its approved permissions. It is not a delivery retry.
workflowUpgrade.stopHint: Stops this run. It does not disable future triggers or close positions.
workflowUpgrade.partialEvents: Some events are unavailable. This is a partial record, not a complete execution trace.
workflowUpgrade.readOnlyHistory: Historical evidence. Inspecting this record does not execute any step.
workflowUpgrade.noRecordedResult: No result has been recorded yet.
workflowUpgrade.noRecordedSteps: No step evidence was recorded. The definition is not an execution trace.
workflowUpgrade.goalPlaceholder: Describe the scope, expected result and when to take no action…
workflowUpgrade.title: Task name
workflowUpgrade.overrideNotice: This override, not the goal text above, will be executed. Review it whenever the goal changes.
workflowUpgrade.overrideStale: The goal changed. Update the override or turn it off before saving.
workflowUpgrade.overrideAcknowledge: Keep this override for the updated goal
workflowUpgrade.overlap: When the previous run is still active
workflowUpgrade.coalesce: Keep only the newest pending occurrence
workflowUpgrade.previewHint: Checks the calendar only. No Agent, order or notification is executed.
workflowUpgrade.noFutureTimes: There are no future occurrences in this schedule window.
workflowUpgrade.intervalUnanchored: The interval is not anchored yet. These times are relative to this preview; the first enabled tick may run immediately.
workflowUpgrade.chooseFold: This local time occurs twice. Select the intended occurrence.
workflowUpgrade.invalid_timezone: Choose a valid IANA time zone, such as Asia/Shanghai.
workflowUpgrade.invalid_local_time: Enter a complete local date and time.
workflowUpgrade.nonexistent_local_time: This local time does not exist because the clock moves forward. Choose another time.
workflowUpgrade.ambiguous_local_time: This local time occurs twice because the clock moves back. Choose the earlier or later occurrence.
workflowUpgrade.invalid_schedule: Check the schedule fields and start/end window.
workflowUpgrade.enableExplicit: Enable future scheduled runs after saving
workflowUpgrade.disabledHint: Saved paused by default. Saving does not run this task.
workflowUpgrade.enabledHint: Future triggers will be enabled after saving. No immediate manual run is requested.
workflowUpgrade.scopeHint: Existing workspace, account and approval restrictions still apply. A prompt does not grant financial permission.
workflowUpgrade.morningGoal: Prepare a market brief for my configured watchlist using timestamped, verifiable sources. Summarize material changes, uncertainty and missing data. Save the report in this task. Do not trade, transfer funds or send external messages.
workflowUpgrade.riskGoal: Review the available account and position snapshots. Explain concentration, exposure and missing or stale data. Save an evidence-backed risk summary. Do not place or cancel orders, transfer funds or change permissions.
workflowUpgrade.dataGoal: Inspect the data used by my configured strategies. Report timestamps, coverage, gaps and stale inputs. Only inspect and report; do not modify strategy files, execute trades or contact external recipients.
workflowUpgrade.automationDescription: Define a task, inspect each run and keep its results together.
workflowUpgrade.emptyAutomationHint: Start with a goal. Tasks stay paused until you explicitly enable them.
workflowUpgrade.configuredNotHealthy: Enabled means scheduled, not a successful or healthy execution.
workflowUpgrade.personalLayout: Layout is saved on this device. It does not change the strategy or its validation.
workflowUpgrade.staticDefinition: Definition only. Lines do not prove that a step ran.
workflowUpgrade.planNotEnabled: Preparing a review plan does not enable it or change trading behavior.
workflowUpgrade.askReviewPlan: Refine the review plan with Agent
workflowUpgrade.reviewPlanRequest: Refine this strategy's separate review plan. Match its timeframe, evidence window, minimum sample requirements, allowed changes, validation and post-change observation. Keep evidence collector → Proposer Agent, and do not enable schedules or trading.
workflowUpgrade.keepsCurrentVersion: Saving a candidate leaves the running version unchanged.
workflowUpgrade.missingCoverage: Coverage was not recorded; do not assume the requested window is complete.
workflowUpgrade.expectedOnly: Expected effects are hypotheses, not observed performance.
workflowUpgrade.reuseHint: Creates a paused draft with these instructions and schedule, without the old account permissions, session binding or delivery recipients.
workflowUpgrade.definitionChanged: The definition changed. Validate the updated schedule before enabling.
workflowUpgrade.noMoneyActions: This check cannot place orders, transfer funds or deliver messages.
